in_arabic.name: Hutun
in_arabic.long_meaning: Hutun هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root h-t-n, meaning 'to give', 'to send', or 'to give a gift'. In Islamic tradition, Hutun symbolizes the blessing of a child and the joy of giving and receiving.
